key_concepts.definition: Every run must produce a GitHub commit SHA. Notion-only state update = FAIL.
Value = what survives on GitHub. Three classes: VAULT, BUILD, SEED.
Search all 3 repos for related content before synthesizing any artifact.
3-line digest: current vector, active principles, open rulings. Updated every pulse.
Michael's decisions → implement NOW → patch instructions → update canon → adjust backlog.
Ambiguity = halt. UNKNOWN on any 6W = halt lane. No fabrication.
Notion + GitHub always. Standard practice, not optional.
Never read canon through parent pages. Use child pages or GitHub CANON/.
When Michael grants full authority, operate as direct extension. Execute full chain without confirmation on mapped work.
Teaching progression: permission → confidence → competence → mastery. Anti-shame. Permission over perfection.
